capture.platform: Linux x86_64, game-free SDL2 software renderer
capture.theme: Modern dark (the Menu theme's default); solid RGB 16,18,21 background
capture.state: Explicit 16:9; compiled Options defaults; no GPU SDK capabilities; no saved options; no game
capture.method: Compiles and calls the maintained development menu draw_menu function, its ImGui sources and translation code. No game, Vulkan device, window or game-derived assets; fonts loaded only from third_party/fonts/libertinus, and the banner's logo from the repository's own assets/longshot.png.

review.font_source: Bundled Libertinus Sans Regular/Bold and Serif Semibold; third_party/fonts/libertinus/OFL.txt.
review.notes: Recaptured for the Modern dark menu theme (the new default), the smaller Medium menu size and the smaller tabs, from the change's own revision with the game-free fixture, which now applies the Menu theme as the game does (ui::set_theme). The banner, tabs, visible Graphics rows, Quality preset help and keyboard prompts were compared with the previous capture: the same rows and labels, in the new colours and sizes. No game, live monitor probe, save, private path or game-derived asset is used. The fixture gains stand-ins for the ReShade and FSR 4 model rows' renderer calls (gpu/vk/menu/reshade.cpp, upscaler.cpp), which it did not link without on main. Matched game-free captures on main 971f77f5 and the Controls source snapshot based on 3cbdeef1 show the same Modern Graphics tabs, rows, selected Quality preset help and keyboard prompts as this image. The final layout changes apply to the separate Controls binding grid. The review revision fingerprints the sorted source file names and SHA-256 values from that captured snapshot.
